sn35.228:1.1: samuddo samuddoti bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
sn35.228:1.3: mahā eso bhikkhave udakarāsi mahā udakaṇṇavo.
sn35.228:2.1: yo taṃ rūpamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave atari cakkhusamuddaṃ saummiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ
sn35.228:2.5: yo taṃ rasamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave atari jivhāsamuddaṃ saummiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ
sn35.228:2.9: yo taṃ dhammamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave atari manosamuddaṃ saummiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ
